subject.title: Feature Request: Image batching / media group buffering at gateway layer

question: Should channels without native grouping metadata, starting with LINE, get opt-in same-sender media batching, a broader shared channel SDK contract, or no heuristic batching support?
rationale: The remaining behavior adds delayed webhook semantics and public configuration for platforms without a reliable album id, so automation should not choose defaults, keying, flush behavior, or plugin-vs-core ownership.

options.title: Plugin-owned batching first
options.body: Add conservative opt-in batching inside affected channel plugins, scoped by account, conversation, sender, and media type, with documented latency tradeoffs.

options.title: Shared SDK contract first
options.body: Design a media-aware channel SDK/core contract before changing LINE, accepting broader architecture and compatibility review.

options.title: Keep unsupported
options.body: Keep only native Telegram album buffering and document that channels without grouping metadata dispatch media events individually.

recommendation.title: Plugin-owned batching first
recommendation.body: Add conservative opt-in batching inside affected channel plugins, scoped by account, conversation, sender, and media type, with documented latency tradeoffs.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses shared debounce, plugin/core boundary, and config policy surfaces where this history is strongest.
